# Hollander Law Firm

> South Florida personal injury law firm specializing in car accidents, medical malpractice, and negligence cases with 30 years of experience across Boca Raton, Fort Lauderdale, and West Palm Beach.

Hollander Law Firm is a leading personal injury practice in South Florida founded by Gregg M. Hollander, serving Broward County and Palm Beach County with free consultations and proven track records of multi-million dollar settlements and verdicts. The firm handles car accident claims, medical malpractice cases, nursing home abuse, and other personal injury matters with experienced legal representation.
